name: Craftsman's Writ: Guardian Cloak
summary: A customer at Ethel Rethor requests a Guardian Cloak through a transferable writ. The cloak will help keep artifacts safe from the naga and centaur.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A faded writ asks you to bring a Guardian Cloak to the marked location. It also gives details for delivery and payment, and the writ can be transferred to another bearer.

sections.title: At Ethel Rethor
sections.body: The customer is studying the mysteries of Ethel Rethor. With the cloak in hand, they plan to wrap artifacts found there and hide them from the naga and centaur.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Guardian Cloak, with delivery and payment details written on the faded note.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Why does the customer want a Guardian Cloak?
faq.answer: The customer intends to use it to wrap artifacts for safekeeping.

faq.q: Who does the customer want to hide artifacts from?
faq.answer: The customer wants to keep artifacts from the naga and centaur at Ethel Rethor.
